title: Persistent Cognitive Architectures for Human-AI Co-Reasoning: Beyond Retrieval to Structural Intelligence
abstract: While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables large language models to access external knowledge, it remains fundamentally reactive and stateless. We present Symbiose, a cognitive architecture that combines graph-based causal reasoning, temporal pattern recognition, and proactive autonomy to enable persistent, evolving collaboration between humans and AI. Components are integrated through Quantum Leap (QL), a persistent cognitive orchestration layer. Every response is tagged via an L0-L3 epistemic framework distinguishing canonical facts from LLM-generated hypotheses.
